text: Samsung Electronics reported quarterly revenue of 171.5 trillion won and operating profit of 89.5 trillion won, with record memory business performance. The company increased memory capital expenditures, expanded HBM4 production and customer supply agreements, and reported continued investment in fabrication capacity and research. Shares closed 0.72% lower.

meta.note: Forward-looking demand statements were excluded; only observed operating and investment conditions are recorded.

text: Shell reported adjusted second-quarter earnings of $9.84 billion, cash flow from operations of $21.4 billion, and net debt of $41.75 billion. The company maintained its capital expenditure outlook of $24-26 billion and continued its $3 billion share buyback program. Shares rose 1.5% following the results.

meta.note: Commodity price discussion was excluded to avoid attributing operating results to external conditions.

text: U.S. real GDP increased at an annualized 1.5% rate in the second quarter. Core PCE inflation measured 3.3% year over year, while headline PCE measured 3.7%. Personal consumption increased 2.1%, inventories declined 0.7%, federal government spending declined 0.3%, and the personal savings rate fell to 2.7%.

meta.note: Growth, inflation, and expenditure components represent concurrent macroeconomic measures.
